name: AWS KMS customer managed key for encryption
summary: If you decide to use a customer managed key, or if your default Amazon EBS encryption key is a customer managed key in member account, you must add permissions to the AWSApplicationMigrationSharingRole_<MANAGEMENT_ACCOUNT_ID> to allow management account to use it.
